question: Xi Jinping out before 2027?
description:
This market will resolve to "Yes" if China's General Secretary of the Communist Party, Xi Jinping, is removed from power for any length of time between July 3, 2025, and December 31, 2026, 11:59 PM ET. Otherwise, this market will resolve to "No".

CCP General Secretary Xi Jinping will be considered removed from power if he announces his resignation from his role as General Secretary, or is otherwise dismissed, detained, disqualified, or otherwise loses his position or is prevented from fulfilling his duties as General Secretary within this market's timeframe.

The primary resolution source for this market will be a consensus of credible reporting.

eventMetadata.context_description: Xi Jinping's consolidated authority as General Secretary of the Chinese Communist Party, chairman of the Central Military Commission, and state president underpins the near-certain trader consensus against removal before 2027. Ongoing purges of senior military and Politburo figures have eliminated potential rivals without triggering visible elite opposition, while public appearances and policy continuity through mid-2026 align with expectations of a fourth term at the 21st Party Congress. Leadership transitions in the CCP historically occur at scheduled congresses rather than through abrupt ousters. Realistic shifts could still arise from an unforeseen health event, a severe economic downturn prompting internal consensus against continued rule, or an external crisis eroding elite cohesion before December 2026.
